_note:
English spellings the tournament feed uses that are not the blade's name here, mapped to its catalogue key. scripts/fetch-tournament.mjs registers these alongside bladeNamesEn/bladeNamesZhEn so a placement still finds its blade.

This exists because the two can legitimately disagree. Takara Tomy's own name for CX-08 03 is Cerberus Dark, and that is what the sheet shows; BBXHub's reporters typed CerberusEclipse for a season and their results should not vanish because we corrected a name. Add an entry when a rename would otherwise strand a record — the typo pass only forgives two edits, which is nowhere near enough to bridge two different words.
